title: Edit-standards suppression of one rule kind never hides later rules
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/astra-rerun-report.md (GPT-6.2 Astra rerun on 075e12b), verified by a read-only reader 2026-11-17.
Evidence: src/hook/edit-standards.ts:110-116: an own exposure with the same scope returns early, so later rules of the file are never shown.
Outcome: a suppressed record skips only itself; later matching rules are still printed.
Proof: a regression test at the lowest layer fails before the fix and passes after.
